subject: your new sdr team
body:
Hi Sam,

Noticed your recent announcement regarding the Senior SDR position supporting outbound expansion.

Organizations establishing outbound development functions frequently underestimate the operational complexity of identifying appropriately qualified prospective accounts. Our platform continuously monitors organizational hiring activity, delivering prioritized opportunities.

Would it help to see the list we would send your team this week?

Alex
evidence: We are building our first outbound SDR team in Austin.
